verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no statement that the Sonar API service's own source is published under an open license. The only open-source mention is the local MCP server, a separate integration component rather than the product itself, so it earns no credit. The GitHub client SDK items likewise describe a client library and never mention a license. missing for 10: published source code for the Sonar API product, an explicit open-source license for that source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Local MCP server: run the open-source server on your machine over stdio.
